question: Victor of Vita says 80,000 Vandals and Alans, of every age and both sexes, crossed to Africa in 429. Estimate their fighting men, in thousands.
answer: Perhaps half of those were of fighting age: about 20,000.
move: Split a headcount into the people who can actually do the job.
trap: Treating all 80,000 as warriors, as if it were an army roll.
hint: Take out the women first, then the children and the old.
steps: Start from 80,000 people of all ages.
Perhaps half of those were of fighting age: about 20,000.

diagram.label: Vandals and Alans
diagram.caption: Of 80,000 who crossed, perhaps 20,000 could fight.

source: Victor of Vita, History of the Vandal Persecution
